submission.justification: Absorber-F2 with 4.5 mm plates achieves the best simulated energy resolution for 100 GeV electrons (2.93%) among all candidate options within the allowed plate thickness range. All design constraints are met: material is in the candidate list, mechanical compatibility and maintenance constraints are addressed in project documents, and silicon-pad readout/cooling are unaffected by absorber choice.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 is explicitly listed as a candidate absorber material.

requirements.requirement: The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns.
requirements.evidence: Meeting notes confirm all absorber options are mechanically compatible; no note of maintenance issues for Absorber-F2.
Chosen plate thickness is 4.5 mm, well within the required range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: Simulation gives 2.93% for 100 GeV electrons—best among all candidates and thicknesses tested.
